envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: Make the proven structured-return seam a durative concept before projection.

payload.gloss: the caller-declared, machine-enforced return shape at a delegation seam: every dispatch supplies a strict schema for that particular seam, and the delegate returns only a value conforming to it, so prose cannot masquerade as a route, verdict or landing. The dispatcher owns the schema; a role's default output shape is neither the contract nor required beside it. A mismatch is refused at the seam and returned to the dispatcher as a failed dispatch, never recorded as a design note or a broken whole and never retried automatically. Unit-loop seams derive their shape from the receiving role and pin the unit's name where applicable; ad-hoc seams declare the shape their request requires. The unit itself carries no transport contract.
